That classification alone does not establish irregularity or wrongdoing by any office or official and should not be represented as such. Absence from an API snapshot likewise does not establish absence from the published NEP or concealment. Read the full notice: https://budget.bettergov.ph/hgab/2027/methodology#disclaimer.

data.title: FY2027 House bill (House Bill 10858) against the NEP
data.summary: For the four programs where the House bill lists projects one by one (DPWH infrastructure, farm-to-market roads, health facilities and irrigation), every project line in the House bill set against the NEP (the budget the President submits to Congress each August): what was added, dropped, raised, reduced or left unchanged.

rules: Amounts are integer pesos. null means the version has no such line, never zero.
The NEP and the House bill are two versions of one budget: compare them, never add them. Sums over a filtered set are given per version and marked not_additive_across_versions.

Pairings are candidates: leads for checking, not confirmed changes. A line found in one version only is an insertion candidate (House bill only) or a deletion candidate (NEP only), never a confirmed insertion or deletion.

Unconfirmed matches (held: fuzzy or ambiguous pairings) are flagged on every row. Bridge figures are the stored ones the pages show: they include unconfirmed matches (fuzzy or ambiguous pairings, counted under 'In the House bill only'), so the six groups add up to net_php. Each group's unconfirmed_rows / unconfirmed_php is the unconfirmed part of it (non-zero only on DPWH house_only). php is the group's money basis: the House amount for house_only and unchanged, the NEP amount for nep_only, the size of the movement for increased and decreased, and the signed net for scope_review. The largest-rows lists leave unconfirmed matches out.

District figures carry their tier. A shared (Tier B) office's money is never divided between the districts it serves, and money under the DPWH Central Office and regional offices, which is on no district card, is returned as the residual.
Rows with a page on the site carry url; document page references carry pdf_url, which opens the source PDF at that page.

Every response carries disclaimers (id, title, body, url): the no-allegations paragraph everywhere, and the office-and-district paragraph as well on office-based views (the district routes and DPWH project lists filtered to one office). Keep them with any figure you republish.

nep.meaning: National Expenditure Program: the budget the President submits to Congress each August.

hgab.meaning: The House of Representatives' version of the budget, House Bill 10858 for 2027. It goes to the Senate next.

reading.meaning: The House votes on a bill twice. The third-reading text is the version it sends to the Senate.

pap.meaning: A heading in the budget under which projects are listed, for example 'Preventive Maintenance - Primary Roads'.

deo.meaning: The DPWH field office that carries out projects in an area. One office can serve more than one congressional district.

fap.meaning: A project paid for partly with a loan or grant from abroad.

candidate.meaning: A match or a gap found by comparing project names, places and amounts. It is a lead for checking, not a confirmed change.

tier.meaning: Tier A: the office serves one district, so its figure can be read as that district’s. Tier B: the office serves several districts, so the figure is shared and is not split between them.

residual.meaning: Money listed under the DPWH Central Office or a regional office. It does not appear on any district card.

stages.meaning: The NEP and the House bill are two versions of the same budget. Compare them; never add them together.

house_only.label: In the House bill only

nep_only.label: In the NEP only
nep_only.help: Projects in the NEP that we could not find in the House bill. They may have been dropped, renamed or merged, so they are called candidates.

unchanged.label: Same amount in both
unchanged.help: Projects found in both documents with the same amount.

increased.label: Higher in the House bill
increased.help: Projects found in both documents where the House bill carries a larger amount than the NEP.

decreased.label: Lower in the House bill
decreased.help: Projects found in both documents where the House bill carries a smaller amount than the NEP.

scope_review.label: Different stretch of the same road
scope_review.help: The same road appears in both documents, but each covers a different stretch of it. The amounts are not comparable, so they are left out of the increases and reductions.

bridge.note: Bridge figures are the stored ones the pages show: they include unconfirmed matches (fuzzy or ambiguous pairings, counted under 'In the House bill only'), so the six groups add up to net_php. Each group's unconfirmed_rows / unconfirmed_php is the unconfirmed part of it (non-zero only on DPWH house_only). php is the group's money basis: the House amount for house_only and unchanged, the NEP amount for nep_only, the size of the movement for increased and decreased, and the signed net for scope_review.

caveats: Only the project lists are compared. DPWH's staff costs, office running costs and a few non-project items are not included.
Foreign-assisted projects are compared as one group.
